title: Soil and Litter GitHub Issues Tracker
text:
I recently updated our model infrastructure by refactoring the soil sensitivity analysis scripts (#419), tested experimental AST-based docstring extraction (#412) and statis VE codebase analysis to map constant–function relationships (#423) for parameterisation, and integrating Copilot skills (#426). Near-term work focuses on verifying an LLM-assisted literature search for model constant values (#431), and futureproof the docs website by pinning documentation rendering versions (#422). For model calibration, I am learning a new workflow using the calibrar package to leverage parallelization, having ruled out Bayesian methods as computationally prohibitive (#404). Jacob and I decided that a “gold standard” subset dataset for validation is not necessary (#425). The data team will revisit config files restructuring (#165), and reorganise tests under the tools directories (#408).




Urgent

Baizurah, TaranRallings, nickwctan to review PR #330 — 329 examine animal continuous state variables from maliau_2
annarallings, nickwctan, arne-exe, Baizurah, lelavathy to review PR #370 — Discuss scenarios of data–prediction (mis)match for validation
davidorme, sallymatson, nickwctan, arne-exe, Baizurah, lelavathy to review PR #384 — Migrate to uv for dependency management and add how-to documentation

Not urgent

annarallings, davidorme to review PR #422 — Pin mkdocs-material version to 9.7.0
annarallings, sallymatson, nickwctan, arne-exe, Baizurah, lelavathy to review PR #373 — Interactive map in R and Python
